item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 10/Jun/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will linger over the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. There will be occasional heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over the region. With the trough of low pressure moving northwards gradually towards inland areas during the weekend, showers will ease off over the coastal areas early next week. But the trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to southern China again midweek next week.
